skill.name: background-removal
skill.description: Remove image backgrounds and create transparent PNGs through the inference.sh belt CLI using BiRefNet and Reve workflows.
skill.summary: Create transparent image cutouts through hosted inference.sh background removal workflows.
skill.author: inference-sh

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md. The main risks are expected external belt CLI execution, hosted image processing, mutable install guidance, and one remote embedded image asset. Several static findings are Markdown fence or placeholder URL false positives.

remediation.issue: Hosted processing receives image URLs and prompts.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before processing private, regulated, or customer-owned images through external inference services.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends npx installation of related skills.
remediation.suggestion: Move related skill installation commands to documentation, or pin reviewed versions and explain the trust boundary.

remediation.issue: Install guidance links to a mutable raw GitHub main-branch file.
remediation.suggestion: Link to a pinned release, tagged commit, or stable documentation page for installation instructions.

remediation.issue: The README embeds a remote image asset.
remediation.suggestion: Use a marketplace-hosted asset or document that rendered views may request cloud.inference.sh.

content.value_statement: Removing image backgrounds often requires manual editing or switching tools. This skill routes Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through belt to create transparent PNGs.
actual_capabilities: Runs BiRefNet background removal through the belt CLI.
Uses Reve workflows to remove or replace image backgrounds.
Accepts image URLs as inputs for hosted model processing.
Returns transparent PNG outputs from supported inference apps.
Shows related inference.sh image workflows and documentation.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated belt CLI.
Processes images through external inference services.
Examples use image URLs, not direct local file uploads.
Results depend on model quality and source image clarity.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Listings
use_cases.description: Create clean transparent product cutouts from catalog photos for ecommerce pages and ads.

use_cases.title: Create Profile Assets
use_cases.description: Remove portrait backgrounds for headshots, bios, and social profiles.

use_cases.title: Build Design Composites
use_cases.description: Generate or edit image elements before placing them into branded layouts.

prompt_templates.title: Remove One Background
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner background removal from a single hosted image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove the background from this image: [image URL]. Return a transparent PNG and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Product Photo
prompt_templates.scenario: Product photo cutout for ecommerce use.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a transparent cutout from this product photo: [image URL]. Preserve the product edges and avoid cropping details.

prompt_templates.title: Replace A Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Change the background of this image to [desired scene]: [image URL]. Keep the subject natural and well lit.

prompt_templates.title: Generate And Cut Out Asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow that creates an image before background removal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of [subject], then remove its background. Keep track of the generated image URL and final transparent PNG.

output_examples.input: A product photo URL with a cluttered desk background.
output_examples.output: A transparent PNG cutout suitable for an online product listing.

output_examples.input: A portrait URL with an indoor background.
output_examples.output: A clean headshot image with the background removed for profile use.

output_examples.input: A generated mascot image that needs design placement.
output_examples.output: A transparent mascot asset ready for a slide, banner, or composition.

best_practices: Use high-resolution images with clear subject boundaries.
Confirm that the image can be processed by external services.
Review transparent edges before publishing final assets.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential images without data handling approval.
Do not expect perfect cutouts from blurred or low-contrast images.
Do not install related skills unless you trust their source.

faq.question: Does this run locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses belt to call hosted inference apps, so images may be processed by external services.

faq.question: What output format should I expect?
faq.answer: The documented output is a PNG with a transparent background.

faq.question: Can it change backgrounds instead of removing them?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes Reve examples for replacing a background with a prompted scene.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The quick start shows belt login before running the model commands.

faq.question: Can I use private images?
faq.answer: Use caution. Confirm data handling before sending private, regulated, or customer-owned images.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
